title: Ice Sorceress Unleashes Vortex
description: A female sorceress with long flowing white hair and ornate blue armor floats dynamically in the sky, wielding a glowing staff in one hand while casting a swirling blue and black vortex of energy with the other. Below her, a dramatic battlefield stretches across a stormy landscape with mounted warriors, tattered banners, and a massive ethereal blue dragon swirling through the chaos under a turbulent purple and orange sky.
prompt: A powerful female ice sorceress with long flowing white braided hair and intricate blue-silver armor levitates in a dramatic pose above a battlefield, holding a glowing magical staff in one hand while casting a swirling vortex of blue and black energy with the other, a massive ethereal blue dragon coils through the scene, warriors on horseback clash below with tattered banners whipping in the wind, dramatic swirling storm clouds in purple orange and teal fill the sky with lightning, highly detailed epic fantasy digital painting
